purpose: Output-parity baselines for the context-fabric Rust port. tf_count and tf_first_results are the golden values produced by text-fabric S.search.

queries.template:
c:clause
/with/
  =: phrase function=Subj
/or/
  := phrase function=Subj
/-/
  phrase
  <: phrase
queries.exercises: /with/ + /or/ quantifier, =: and := positional, named atom, <: adjacency
